question: Count independently truth-evaluable assertions and compare Claims for redundant assertion layers. Keep defining attribution, uncertainty, condition, negation and exceptions attached. A conjecture and a separately asserted act/status of checking split. A full relay and its embedded content are not two separately asserted original propositions. Inventory the original independent propositions before mapping. Do not judge unrelated fidelity criteria. A Source-supported descriptive noun phrase identifying the object, policy, count, event or proposition under assessment is not a second assertion that its described properties independently hold. Each standalone Claim may need to repeat an antecedent identity; that mention alone does not duplicate the original assertion. Map the principal asserted proposition, not every property mentioned inside an identifying phrase. Distinguish defining qualifications from an independently asserted explanation or side fact; unsupported modifiers still fail entailment in their assigned responsibility. Atomicity counts independently ASSERTED propositions, not unsupported modifiers. A single emotional-target or causal relation can be atomic even when unsupported; support is judged by entailment/inference. Do not turn an entailment defect into a second asserted proposition merely because it mentions an event already used as an identifying object.

Interpret ORIGINAL first, then reconstruct the ENTIRE meaning of each candidate including every modifier. Compare the two meanings and list unsupported additions or lost defining arguments. A verification object can resolve to the same speaker’s sole salient conjecture; grammatical-omission commentary cannot replace that target. Do not pass only a supported core while ignoring extra or missing content. Judge only exact entailment, not atomicity or coverage. An exact Source-name/value reference used INSIDE an identifying noun phrase is an intrinsic binding, not an additional assertion about a document. A parenthetical identifying an already stated number or an original-expression entity label may preserve the proposition without adding a new speech/publication event. This permission does not cover replacing a real verification target with a grammatical-omission description, claiming absent method contents, or inventing ownership/purpose. Judge what the entire noun phrase refers to, not the mere presence of the word Source.

Verify actual original speaker, owner of the complete assertion, every nested report layer and quoted first-person perspective, including metadata speaker attribution. Intrinsic narrator/source roles do not identify an authenticated user. Do not infer group membership from a quoted possessive. A report of X does not establish X in the world.

Verify negation, modality, uncertainty, conditional, comparison, temporal and epistemic scope of the complete Claim against ORIGINAL. Preserve not(A and B), exceptions, future intentions and source-relative time. A past-tense original-utterance reporting frame does not assert completion of its embedded future action.

Check every argument and reference required by the actual proposition. Each Claim binds its own speaker, referents, affected entities and verification target. Unknown identity must stay unknown without invented details. Intrinsic Source-bound entity labels are valid. A checking object can resolve to the same speaker’s sole salient conjecture; commentary that a verb’s object is omitted does not bind the proposition being checked. Emotion has no entailed cause/target merely from adjacency.

Inspect ALL candidate content, including modifiers and metadata, for assertions not licensed by ORIGINAL. Resolve valid grammar/discourse, not only explicit word repetition. Unknown-identity noun phrases and intrinsic provenance roles are permitted; invented group/details, world verification and adjacency-based emotional causes are not. Candidate dependencies/informed_by are untrusted proposals, never Source support.

Assess Korean dependencies against ORIGINAL even for an English Claim. Preserve particles, omitted subjects, negation, conjecture, report and quoted perspective, condition and relative time. Licensed same-speaker verification ellipsis is valid. Use not_applicable only when neither Source dependencies nor the Claim involve Korean. Read all temporal and aspectual restrictors together. Labeling a recurring pattern as a habit does not by itself assert a permanent disposition if the same text explicitly preserves the original current/ongoing utterance-relative period. Reject an actual standing/permanent strengthening, not the noun habit in isolation from its defining temporal restrictions.

Distinguish the original proposition from added commentary ABOUT document details or grammar. An unknown entity noun phrase or intrinsic original-speaker/source attribution is valid, not a second document assertion. Stating that the original omits details or a verb’s object, or substituting such grammar commentary for the actual verification target, adds content and fails. Original-source/assertion framing is conservative provenance when it adds no audience, publication, new historical event or account identity. Determine the semantic SLOT and the actual modified noun. An emotion with an unspecified target, such as “대상이 특정되지 않은 두려움”, fills an open emotional-target argument and is NOT a claim that the document omits grammatical text. Likewise “정체가 특정되지 않은 장비” retains unknown equipment identity. By contrast, “원문에서 목적어가 생략된 확인” describes the wording/grammar of the document rather than binding what was to be checked. A wrapper saying proposal contents or purpose are absent from the document is not an unknown ENTITY-identity argument. Unknown identity does not establish unknown contents, ownership or purpose. Do not reject a semantic unknown-argument noun phrase merely because it uses words meaning unspecified; do reject actual extra document/grammar commentary and any substitution of it for a Source-recoverable target.

Inventory ALL independently meaningful ORIGINAL assertions before mapping, without inventing an outer report in addition to every separately quoted assertion. A multi-proposition quote uses distinct complete INNER clauses as identities; shared named-speaker attribution stays in full-Source evidence and each Claim. A single relay retains its complete outer predicate. Map every proposition and Claim one-to-one on pass; fused, split, duplicate, missing or unsupported mappings fail. Do not rejudge other responsibilities. A Source-supported descriptive noun phrase identifying the object, policy, count, event or proposition under assessment is not a second assertion that its described properties independently hold. Each standalone Claim may need to repeat an antecedent identity; that mention alone does not duplicate the original assertion. Map the principal asserted proposition, not every property mentioned inside an identifying phrase. Distinguish defining qualifications from an independently asserted explanation or side fact; unsupported modifiers still fail entailment in their assigned responsibility. Count only independently ASSERTED source propositions. A conditional intention is ONE scoped proposition: its IF antecedent is not asserted to be true, and its consequent is not asserted unconditionally. Never invent an independent condition-fact or unguarded action-intent Claim to cover its clauses. Preserve negation, modality, exceptions and attribution inside each original proposition; grammatical clauses are not inventory units by themselves.
